gloss: shuttered shopping street; street of closed-up shops

definitions.gloss: shuttered shopping street; street of closed-up shops
definitions.explanation: A shopping street where many shops have closed and rolled their shutters down for good, leaving the arcade half-empty — a symbol of decline in local retail districts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧シャッター{通|どお}りになった。
examples.english: The area in front of the station has become a shuttered shopping street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シャッター{通|どお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Shuttered shopping streets are increasing in regional commercial districts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦にぎやか→にぎやか：00873_nigiyaka⟧だった⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧シャッター{通|どお}りだ。
examples.english: The shopping street that was once lively is now completely shuttered.

notes:
From ⟦シャッター→シャッター：06380_shattaa⟧ (shop shutter) + {通|どお}り (street). A shopping arcade where so many businesses have closed that the shutters stay down along the street. Often cited as a sign of rural depopulation and competition from large suburban stores.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シャッター{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into a shuttered street
- ⟦シャッター→シャッター：06380_shattaa⟧{街|がい}: shuttered district (synonym)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧: shopping street/arcade — the kind of district that becomes a シャッター{通|どお}り
